name: Nick Carraway
brief: The narrator, a man inclined to reserve all judgments who has come East to learn the bond business and rents a house in West Egg.

name: Gatsby
brief: A mysterious neighbor of Nick's, a man of heightened sensitivity to the promises of life who stretches his arms toward the dark water in a curious way.

name: Tom Buchanan
brief: A sturdy, straw-haired man of thirty with arrogant eyes and a cruel body, former football star at New Haven now living in East Egg.

name: Daisy Buchanan
brief: Nick's second cousin, a woman with a low thrilling voice and bright eyes, whose laughter and voice compel attention with a singing compulsion.

name: Jordan Baker
brief: A slender, small-breasted girl with an erect carriage and grey sun-strained eyes, apparently a golfer or athlete of some accomplishment.

name: Myrtle Wilson
brief: A woman in her middle thirties with an immediately perceptible vitality and continually smouldering nerves, the mistress of Tom Buchanan.

name: George B. Wilson
brief: A blond, spiritless, anaemic man and proprietor of a garage in the valley of ashes who appears to be under the thumb of his wife.

name: Catherine
brief: A slender, worldly girl of about thirty with a red bob of hair, the sister of Myrtle Wilson who lives with a girl friend at a hotel.

name: Mr. McKee
brief: A pale, feminine man from the flat below who is in the artistic game and has made an enlargement of Mrs. Wilson's mother for her wall.

name: Mrs. McKee
brief: The shrill, languid, and handsome wife of Mr. McKee, who has been photographed by her husband more than a hundred times since their marriage.
